one_month_reasoning: Window 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-31. Scheduled: Hudbay's Q3 2026 results; Q2 was released 29 Jul (pre-market), so Q3 most likely lands in late Oct to early/mid Nov and may or may not fall inside the window (no date announced yet). Q3 should be solid on volumes (guidance reaffirmed, cash-cost guidance improved) but realized copper averaged roughly flat to Q2 and gold fell from ~$4,450 (Aug 31) to ~$4,157 (Sep 30) on Kalshi settlements, so no clear surprise direction. Copper World sanction decision is guided for 'late 2026'; I put ~15% odds it lands in October (mild +). Macro driver is copper: Kalshi settlements show COMEX-type copper slipped from $6.78/lb (Sep 25) to $6.64 (Sep 30) and $6.58 (Oct 2); the Oct-30 Kalshi monthly book is centred near $6.55 (about flat), i.e. no strong directional signal. Social sentiment (LunarCrush) is very positive and the stock has strong 12-month momentum, but after a +77% year and a pullback from the $32 high, momentum and mean-reversion roughly offset. So I stay near a symmetric lognormal around ~$26.1 with monthly vol ~17-18% (63%/3.5), shading the median a hair below spot for the early-October copper dip.

fair_value.method: Blend of 2027E EV/EBITDA (7.0x on ~$1.45B, $23.0), SOTP (operating assets 6x 2027E EBITDA + risked 70% Copper World + Cactus + net cash, $25.9) and P/E (20x ~$1.35 2027E EPS, $27.0) on ~445M shares -> ~$25.

methods.name: EV/EBITDA
methods.inputs: 2027E EBITDA $1.45B x 7.0x = EV $10.15B; + net cash $0.08B; / 445M shares = $23.0

bear.story: Copper unwinds toward $5/lb on demand or tariff-driven destocking and gold slips; the Copper World DFS shows a large capex jump or sanction slips into 2027; EBITDA falls to ~$1.0B and the multiple compresses to 6x. Stock round-trips toward the lower part of its 52-week range.

base.story: Copper stays ~$6-6.8/lb, production steps up toward ~150kt in 2027, Copper World is sanctioned late 2026/early 2027 with manageable capex inflation, and FCF builds net cash. Stock tracks fair value plus modest growth.

bull.story: Copper breaks to new highs ($7.5+/lb) on supply deficits; Copper World sanction plus Cactus PFS re-rate Hudbay as a US copper growth story (Simply Wall St community fair value up to CA$55); multiple expands to ~9x forward EBITDA.

thesis_break_reason: At ~$17 (-35%) the market cap (~$7.6B) would be below my value of the three operating mines alone at 6x 2027E EBITDA, giving no credit for Copper World or Cactus. Trading there would most likely mean a fundamental break (copper price collapse below ~$5/lb, a Copper World capex/sanction failure, or an operating/political shock at Constancia in Peru) rather than ordinary 63%-vol noise.

reasoning: HBM is Hudbay Minerals. Its last close of $26.18 implies ~ $11.6B market cap on ~445M shares (after 46.8M shares were issued for Arizona Sonoran) and EV ~ 8.9x the record $1.3B TTM EBITDA. My three-method fair value is ~$25, roughly at the current price: the market already credits Copper World and Cactus at about my risked values. In my lane, the most useful alternative signal is the Kalshi commodity prediction markets. COMEX-type copper settled $6.58 (Aug 31), $6.64 (Sep 30) and $6.58 (Oct 2), and the Oct-30 book is centred near $6.55, so the market sees copper flat-ish near highs. Gold settled lower in September ($4,448 to $4,157). Social sentiment (LunarCrush) is strongly positive, and a Simply Wall St community narrative (Sep 30) values the stock at CA$44.5 using a rich 25.5x PE. I treat that as a bullish sentiment marker, not a valuation. An FXEmpire newsletter flags downside risk for copper as an LME squeeze unwinds. No credible Substack or Reddit deep-dive with new facts turned up, and X was not reachable, so research is limited there. Sell-side estimates were not retrievable: Twelve Data is behind a paywall and Alpha Vantage was rate-limited, so the EPS and EBITDA inputs are my own builds from reported Q2 data and the company's 3-year outlook. The 12-month distribution is a lognormal mixture: 85% weight with sigma 0.47 and 15% with sigma 0.80 for copper-crash and boom tails, median ~$25.8, near fair value with a small growth tilt. I use forward vol below the 63% realized because the past year included a big re-rating, though fat tails are kept for commodity regime shifts. The scenario mean ($27.25) is close to the ladder's central tendency. One month: symmetric around spot at ~17% monthly vol, with a slight downward tilt for copper's early-October dip.
